description: `plugin/governance/decision-autonomy.md` `## Disposition Vocabulary` resolves every Tier-B decision to EXACTLY ONE of four dispositions, so each disposition must name exactly one destination or the enumeration overlaps itself and a single residual satisfies two names at once. The source pin sits on the clause that makes `deferred` one-to-one with its destination and carries BOTH halves of that binding: the positive half (only a tracked follow-up makes a disposition `deferred`: it DEFINES the disposition, not merely one available destination for it) and the exclusive half (a residual in the repository's durable design record is `recorded`, never `deferred`). Deleting either half — including a rewrite back to the overlapping sense in which a repository-recorded residual could also count as `deferred` — turns the suite red. The fixture names no consumer: the only consumer was the decision-report skill, retired with the report, and the source pin stays. What this pin honestly guarantees is exactly that this word sequence exists in the one named file; it claims nothing about meaning. Residuals, stated plainly: (1) a meaning inversion that leaves the pinned bytes intact is invisible — surrounding prose that re-opens the repository record as a second `deferred` destination stays green; (2) the reciprocal half stated in the `recorded` bullet (that the scope requirement is identical and only the destination differs) is deliberately OUTSIDE the pinned span, so deleting that sentence alone stays green; (3) this fixture DELIBERATELY does not pin the sites that replicate the four-value disposition ENUM — the run-ledger schema, the overlord and local-reviewer agents, and the consumer glossary — because that replication is itself tracked for removal, and pinning it here would entrench the pattern that work exists to delete; (4) the pin sees only the one file it names, and no fixture in this directory can detect a NEW disposition bullet, or a new consumer of the disposition vocabulary, that never states its destination binding at all — that is an absence defect per rule 7 of the pin-authoring contract and needs a structural check, not a presence pin.

source.pattern: Only a tracked follow-up makes a disposition `deferred`; a residual in the repository's durable design record is `recorded`, never `deferred`
